g.text: Recommended: invented venue, real product writes
A frozen older image creates Olivo Test: staff, menus, sales and invoices through its normal product paths. All people and keys are test-only.
Closer to a particular box, but brings private records and credentials. Cleaning them can also change the case you wanted to preserve.
Should the required fixture be an invented venue created by an older image (recommended: Ana’s 0.350 kg cheese sale must still be 0.350 kg after
upgrade), or an actual private venue snapshot with a separately approved custody process?
Illustrative review board. No implementation is approved.
